frame: World CAD coordinates: bed X0..350; revision-34 bed front edge Y40; nozzle positions.
method: Active tool + revision-37 carriage (both probes) moved toward the rack at nozzle X0..350 every 1 mm, from the audited corridor in 2 mm steps, first exact contact bisected to 0.01 mm. Fixed: all ten bays with both parked tool variants, ten docks, crossbar, P29/P30 mounts, flying gantry with Y rails. The limit is then re-verified every 0.1 mm of X.
limitations: Every bay holds both parked tool variants at once and the active tool's own bay counts as occupied: conservative for any real mix of tools.
Parked tools sit on the modeled dock seat; the margin covers small seating and frame errors only.
Hoses, cable chains, umbilicals and toolhead wiring are not modeled.
Tool changes run forward of this limit, so a Klipper Y soft limit cannot enforce it: use the slicer bed shape (or an excluded front strip) and keep the toolchange macros' straight-Y bay moves.
World CAD coordinates; commission the firmware/slicer values on the machine.
